id.description: This is the unique identifier for the simulation run item.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the organization.

simulationId.description: This is the ID of the simulation this run belongs to.

status.description: This is the current status of the run.

queuedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run was queued.

startedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run started.

completedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run completed.

failedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run failed.

canceledAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run was canceled.

failureReason.description: This is the reason for failure.

callId.description: This is the ID of the target Vapi call (the assistant being tested).

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run item was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the run item was last updated.

runId.description: This is the ID of the parent run (batch/group).

hooks.description: Hooks configured for this simulation run item

iterationNumber.description: This is the iteration number (1-indexed) when run with iterations > 1.

sessionId.description: This is the session ID for chat-based simulations (webchat transport).

scenarioId.description: This is the scenario ID at run creation time.

personalityId.description: This is the personality ID at run creation time.

metadata.description: This is the metadata containing snapshots and call data.

results.description: This is the results of the simulation run.

improvementSuggestions.description: This is the AI-generated improvement suggestions for failed runs.

configurations.description: This is the configuration for how this simulation run executes.
